## Outcome

Describe the learner-visible change and its limits.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has deterministic tests.
- [ ] Unsupported behavior and safety limits remain visible.
- [ ] No credentials, private topology, generated bundle, binary, archive, or compiled firmware is included.
- [ ] The contribution is original or its exact source/licence/notice obligations are documented.
- [ ] No copied simulator layout, artwork, schema, endpoint, documentation, logo, or branding is included.
